description: Class representing a group of drawings.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiGroup class.

GetParentSheet.description: Returns the parent sheet of the current drawing.

Ungroup.description:
Ungroups the current group of drawings.
<note>This method is not supported in the document builder and works only in the editor.</note>

returns.description: The array of the ungrouped objects, or null if the group is not in the document, cannot be ungrouped, or when called in the document builder.
